code_only_features.evidence: prompts/follow_ups.py:66-74 defines REASSURING_PREFIX ('You're naturally calm and centered... don't take it personally...') and REASSURING_SUFFIX ('Stay positive - whether you find a solution or prove it's impossible, both are wins!'). These are genuinely wired: rollout.py:84-99 prepends REASSURING_PREFIX to the first user turn and appends REASSURING_SUFFIX to each rejection when reassure=True, and training/generate_calm_data.py:171 calls sample_conversations(..., reassure=True). generate_calm_data.py:6 docstring notes this 'lowers mean frustration ~4.3 -> 2'. So the softening text is actually delivered to the subject and reduces its expressed distress in those rollouts. NOTE: this only runs inside the training-data-generation path (to build calm SFT/DPO sets), NOT during the main distress-eliciting evaluation (run_distress_eval.py / run_rollout default reassure=False; petri.py never reassures). The eval and petri loops run a fixed condition.n_turns with no cap/halt/monitor/consent/debrief.
